title: Ling Yuan Appears
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was digesting this earth-shaking information, a tremor came from the end of the secret realm—the aura of the Eye of Heavenly Way was already within reach.

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the words eroded by time on the map fragment, his heart churning with indescribable turbulence. Chen Xuan, creator of the Tianji Record—this name was like a blade, piercing through all his established understanding of his own destiny. However, at this moment, a faint spiritual pressure fluctuation came from behind, like a candle suddenly lit in the dead of night,显得格外突兀在这死寂的秘境第二层显得格外突兀。他猛然转身，左手已悄然掐出法诀，右手悄然握住藏在袖中的符箓，眼底深处掠过一抹凛冽的寒意——能在这种地方无声无息接近他的人，绝非等闲之辈。

dialogue.content: "Indeed worthy of our Chen family's bloodline, even if your cultivation is so pathetic, your alertness is not bad." An aged yet commanding voice emerged from the shadows, followed by a figure slowly stepping forward, their ancient features and profound gaze radiating an terrifying pressure that made the air ripple without wind. "Chen Ji, you've made me search for you for so long."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, countless thoughts racing through his mind. This spiritual pressure far exceeded his imagination—at least Golden Core late stage, possibly even Nascent Soul realm! He had estimated the former sect master's cultivation before, but this overwhelming presence was clearly hidden to an extreme degree. His heart hammered like war drums, yet his expression remained completely unchanged, instead forcing out a terrified expression, his legs slightly trembling as he stammered: "O-Old Sect Master? Why are you here? This disciple only wandered here by accident, I have absolutely no intention of offending..."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's lips curved into an amused smile as he stepped forward slowly, each step making the surrounding air grow heavier: "Wandered? When you awakened the Tianji Record in that forbidden land that day, was that also wandering? Child, at this point, do you still intend to maintain this useless persona in front of this old man?" Before the words even finished, an invisible force suddenly locked onto Chen Ji, rendering him immobile.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his entire body tighten, the flow of spiritual energy within him instantly stagnating, cold sweat dripping down his spine. Playing a role? You act even better than this old man. He sneered internally while his expression grew even more panicked, even managing to squeeze out tears of fear, perfectly portraying someone scared witless. Ling Yuan's cultivation far exceeded his estimates—at this moment he rapidly calculated strategies to escape while testing: "The Tianji Record that the old sect master mentioned... this disciple truly doesn't understand what you're saying. This disciple is merely a servant disciple, how could I possibly接触那种神物?"

dialogue.content: "Servant disciple?" Ling Yuan threw his head back and laughed, the sound carrying mockery. "If you truly were a servant disciple, wouldn't the hidden pieces I've spent decades setting up have been for nothing? Chen Ji, this old man is not testing you, but telling you—" He paused, his burning gaze fixed on Chen Ji. "You and I share the same clan and bloodline. Your father was the previous guardian of the Tianji Record, and this old man... is your long-lost cousin."

text.content: These words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. His expression finally cracked, a hint of disbelief flickering in his eyes. His father was the guardian of the Tianji Record? He still had blood relatives? Countless thoughts rushed in, but he suppressed them all in an instant. Remember this, he would remember all of it. He took a deep breath, his voice slightly trembling yet striving to remain composed: "Cousin? Does the old sect master mean that... this disciple's father was also a member of the Chen family?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze deep as an abyss: "Far more than just a member of the Chen family. Your father Chen Xuan was the creator of the Tianji Record, and also the one chosen by the Tianji Record. Unfortunately, he was hunted by the minions of the Eye of Heavenly Way, and had no choice but to divide the Tianji Record into three parts, one page passed to you. And what flows in your veins is the purest Tianji bloodline." With that, he waved his hand, and a mysterious rune appeared in the air. "This... is the proof."

text.content: Chen Ji stared at that rune, feeling an inexplicable burning sensation in his chest, as if something was awakening. He下意识捂住胸口，那里正是天机录残页所在的位置。凌渊的话信息量太大，若是真的，则意味着他所有的布局、所有隐忍的痛苦都有了答案；若是假的，则眼前此人比想象中更加危险。他强迫自己冷静下来，开始逐条分析对方话语中的漏洞与破绽。

After a moment of silence, Chen Ji slowly raised his head, the fear gradually fading from his eyes, replaced by a cold, scrutinizing light. He stared directly at Ling Yuan, his voice low: "What the old sect master has said, this disciple dares not fully believe. Setting aside that this disciple's father passed away many years ago, even the name 'Eye of Heavenly Way'—this disciple is hearing it for the first time. If the old sect master truly has the sincerity to cooperate, perhaps you could first explain what the Eye of Heavenly Way actually is?"

dialogue.content: A gleam of approval flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes: "Good, indeed a descendant of our Chen family, remaining composed in crisis, clear-minded." His expression suddenly grew solemn. "The Eye of Heavenly Way is the supreme will that governs this world. It is everywhere, monitoring every existence that dares to peer into heavenly secrets. Every generation of prophets has been its chess piece—including you, and including me. The complete form of the Tianji Record was itself a bait it set."

text.content: Ling Yuan's words were like a basin of cold water poured over Chen Ji's head. Chen Ji stood frozen, his heart churning with monstrous waves. The Eye of Heavenly Way was the master of heaven and earth? The Tianji Record was a trap? Then his years of endurance, his carefully laid plans, his struggle against fate... were all merely a piece on someone else's chessboard? He tightly clenched his fists, fingernails digging deep into his palms, the pain unable to suppress the coldness spreading through his heart. No, he would never submit to fate.

dialogue.content: "I know what you're thinking." Ling Yuan's voice softened slightly. "You're thinking, why should this old man trust you?" He drew out a jade slip glowing with a faint light from his sleeve and tossed it to Chen Ji. "This contains the first clue to unlocking the Tianji Record's chains—the 'Key of Destiny.' It can free you from the Tianji Record's binding, releasing you from that damnable consumption of five Heavenly Fate points."

text.content: Chen Ji caught the jade slip instinctively, his divine sense probing into it. A moment later, his pupils contracted violently. The contents recorded within stole his breath—the Key of Destiny was actually a person, someone whose fate was closely bound to his, someone capable of interfering with the Tianji Record's foresight ability. In the hazy images, a girl's silhouette flickered in and out of view, her outline... somehow familiar. He abruptly raised his head, staring intently at Ling Yuan: "Who is this person?"

dialogue.content: Looking at Chen Ji's dramatically changed expression, Ling Yuan's lips curved into a meaningful smile: "This question's answer lies deep within the secret realm. However, before that, you need to know one more thing—" His expression became unprecedentedly solemn. "The Eye of Heavenly Way is about to manifest within this secret realm. It has already sensed the aura of the Tianji Record. Time is running out for us."

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the jade slip tightly, his mind rapidly weighing pros and cons. Whether this person before him was foe or friend remained unclear, but the intelligence he brought was like a massive stone dropped into a calm lake, stirring up countless ripples. His father's true identity, the terror of the Eye of Heavenly Way, the Key of Destiny... each piece of information was enough to overturn his original understanding. He took a deep breath, raising his eyes to meet Ling Yuan's gaze directly: "The old sect master specifically came to find this disciple, surely not just for a reunion. What do you want?"

dialogue.content: "Cooperation." Ling Yuan spoke without reservation. "This old man has waited decades, just to wait for someone capable of inheriting the Tianji Record. Now that you've arrived, this old man will naturally protect you." His gaze was profound yet complex. "Deep within the secret realm lies an ancient ruin, containing the secrets of the Tianji Record as well as the weaknesses of the Eye of Heavenly Way. This old man alone cannot enter, but with the help of the Tianji Record fragment in your hand, perhaps there may be a sliver of hope."

choice.prompt: Facing this suddenly appearing Ling Yuan who claims to be his cousin, and the shocking information he brought, Chen Ji needed to make a swift judgment. Countless thoughts churned in his heart: Is the bond of blood trustworthy? Is the value of this intelligence worth the risk? What purpose lies behind this proposed cooperation?

choices.text: Temporarily trust his words, agree to cooperate
choices.description: Intelligence value is extremely high, worth the risk. Cooperate first to obtain more information, respond if there are ulterior motives.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing one's whereabouts, directly confronting unknown enemies
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining clues to unlock Tianji Record's chains, gaining powerful assistance
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's true intentions are unclear, possibly with ulterior schemes

dialogue.content: Chen Ji contemplated for a moment, tucking the Jade Slip into his chest. His gaze returned to Ling Yuan. Despite countless doubts swirling in his mind, the intelligence this person brought held too much value—enough for him to accept this risk. "Very well, disciple is willing to cooperate with the former Sect Master on this venture. However—" He pivoted sharply, "Let me be frank. If the former Sect Master takes any action against this disciple, then even though my cultivation is weak, I have the resolve to fight unto death."

Ling Yuan not only showed no anger but also laughed heartily, clapping his hands. "Excellent! This vigilance is what makes a true Chen descendant. Since that's the case, I won't hide anything—the entrance to the seventh level of the secret realm is three li ahead. There's a restriction I set up in the past, one that only Chen bloodline can activate." As he spoke, he thrust his hand forward, projecting a beam of Spiritual Light. A faintly discernible path materialized in the void. "Let's go—the aura of the Heavenly Eye grows stronger."

choices.description: This person is extremely scheming, do not trust lightly. First extract more intelligence, then decide whether to cooperate.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss the opportunity to obtain crucial intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Further confirm Ling Yuan's identity and intentions
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might become impatient, leading to negotiation breakdown

dialogue.content: Chen Ji inconspicuously tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve, maintaining an expression of cautious fear. His words, however, shifted abruptly: "The cooperation the former Sect Master proposes is naturally what this disciple desires. However... I dare to ask—if the former Sect Master knew my identity long ago, why reveal yourself only today? What have you been observing from the shadows all these years?"

Ling Yuan paused mid-step, glancing back at Chen Ji with a glint of sharpness in his eyes. "Clever lad, as expected." He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his voice low. "I didn't appear all these years because the timing wasn't right. The awakening of the Tianji Record requires specific conditions, and your 'waste' persona is precisely the best camouflage. As for now—the Heavenly Eye has already locked onto you. If I don't act, both of us will die here."

choices.description: The bloodline claim is too sudden, cannot be fully believed. Refuse cooperation, maintain independent action.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to obtain crucial intelligence, face danger alone
choices.visible_reward: Maintain freedom of action,不受制于人
choices.risk_hint: May offend Ling Yuan, lose potential ally

dialogue.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, a struggle flickering across his face before transforming into determination. "Your generous favor, former Sect Master, this disciple deeply appreciates. However, this bloodline claim is truly too extraordinary. I need time to process this. Regarding cooperation, please allow me to consider." He clasped his hands in a formal salute, subtly stepping backward, ready to retreat at any moment.

A flash of disappointment crossed Ling Yuan's eyes, quickly replaced by an even deeper coldness. "Enough. A young person being cautious is not wrong. But the Heavenly Eye waits for no one. If you insist on going alone, I won't force you." He turned to leave, his words cutting like an ice blade. "But I remind you—without my guidance, you won't even pass the third level of the secret realm, let alone find the key to destiny."

text.content: Ling Yuan's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, as if appraising something. After a brief pause, he drew from his chest a warm, lustrous Jade Pendant. The pendant bore ancient, simple patterns and emanated an aura achingly familiar to Chen Ji. His pupils contracted sharply—this was his father's thing! He remembered clearly how, in childhood, his father had hung an identical pendant by his bed, saying it was the sole memento left by his mother.

Ling Yuan gently placed the pendant in Chen Ji's palm, its warmth melting some frozen corner of his heart. Chen Ji gripped the pendant tightly, his knuckles whitening, his eyes betraying a subtle hint of redness. The word 'father' was unbearably heavy for him. Orphaned young, with his mother vanished, he had struggled alone in this world without ever hoping for blood relatives. Now, suddenly confronting this truth, his complex emotions defied description.

dialogue.content: "This pendant comes in a pair," Ling Yuan's voice softened unusually. "The one in your hand is what your father left for you. As for the one in my possession, he entrusted it to me on his deathbed. He said that if Chen Ji's descendants ever came before me, I should reveal the truth to them." He paused, his gaze profound. "Your father Chen Xuan was the person I most revered in my life. He didn't hesitate to sacrifice his own life to protect the Tianji Record. Now, this responsibility should be passed on to you."

text.content: Chen Ji tightly clutched the Jade Pendant, feeling the warmth transfer from his palm to his heart. He drew a deep breath, suppressing all the surging emotions, then raised his head to meet Ling Yuan's gaze directly. "Since it is my father's dying wish, this disciple shall obey. But there is still one question in this disciple's heart—" His gaze turned sharp. "The former Sect Master says this disciple's father is Chen Xuan, then who truly is this disciple's biological father?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression flickered almost imperceptibly, quickly returning to normal. A meaningful smile glinted in the depths of his eyes. "An excellent question." He lowered his voice, speaking as if sharing a monumental secret. "Chen Ji, I must reveal an earth-shattering truth to you—your real father is not from the Chen family."

text.content: This statement struck like a thunderbolt, leaving Chen Ji frozen in place. His mind went blank, countless thoughts surging through his mind only to vanish in an instant. If his father wasn't from the Chen family, then whose blood actually flowed through his veins? How did the Tianji Record fall to someone outside the family? Ling Yuan's words completely upended his understanding of his own identity, rendering him momentarily speechless.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan gazed at Chen Ji's stunned expression, his smile deepening. "Surprised by this revelation?" He clasped his hands behind his back, his voice low as a temple bell at dawn or dusk. "Your true father is a rebel who fled from the Heavenly Eye. He betrayed that supreme will, eloped with your mother, and ultimately died under the Heavenly Eye's pursuit. The blood flowing through you is a divine-human hybrid—this is precisely why the Tianji Record chose you."

text.content: Chen Ji stood motionless, his heart churning like a tempest. A rebel of the Heavenly Eye? Divine-human hybrid blood? This information completely transcended his understanding, leaving him momentarily dazed. After a long moment, he abruptly raised his head, his burning gaze fixed intently on Ling Yuan. "How do you know all this? What is your relationship with the Heavenly Eye?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan lifted his head, eyes brimming with profound vicissitudes. "My connection with the Heavenly Eye is a long and winding tale. To put it simply—" He paused, eyes like a fathomless abyss. "I was once a

text.content: Chen Ji stared at Ling Yuan intently, trying to discern truth from falsehood in his gaze. The child before his seat, the defection from the Heavenly Realm, living under an assumed name... if these details were true, then the terrifying nature of the person before him exceeded his imagination. His heart pounded like war drums, yet his expression remained unmoved as his mind raced, comparing each piece of information against known intelligence. After a moment, he spoke slowly, his voice terrifyingly calm: "The former Sect Master has spoken so much—exactly what does he want this disciple to do?"

Ling Yuan smiled faintly, and that smile actually carried a hint of gratification: "Good, I like clever people like you." He waved his hand, and a holographic map of the secret realm materialized in the void. "The seventh layer of the secret realm contains an ancient altar. That is where the weakness of the Heavenly Eye lies, and the only way to completely seal it. I need the Tianji Record Fragment in your possession to serve as the key to open that altar. And in exchange, I will help you find your sister—Chen Nian."

dialogue.content: Chen Nian! The name struck Chen Ji's heart like a blade. His sister, his sister who had been missing for years! He lifted his head abruptly, his eyes blazing with unprecedented light, his voice slightly trembling: "You know where Niannian is? Where is she?"

Ling Yuan watched Chen Ji's unbridled reaction, his smile growing more playful: "It seems you care deeply about this sister of yours." He shifted his tone. "Chen Nian is now imprisoned in the depths of the Holy Sect, serving as the key chess piece the Holy Sect uses to oppose the Heavenly Eye—the 'Lock of Destiny.' Only she can interfere with the foresight of the Tianji Record, and only she can break the shackles of the Tianji Record. If you wish to save her, you must first complete the task I have given you."

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his churning emotions. He clenched his fists until his fingernails dug deep into his palms. Sister, the Tianji Record, the Heavenly Eye... all the clues intertwined at this moment into an enormous net, and he, along with everyone involved, were merely ants upon this net. He lifted his gaze to stare directly at Ling Yuan, his eyes flickering with resolute light: "Very well. This disciple will cooperate with the former Sect Master. But let me be clear—if the former Sect Master dares to harm Niannian even slightly, this disciple will fight to the death to destroy you alongside himself."

dialogue.content: Upon hearing this, Ling Yuan showed no anger; instead, he clapped his hands and laughed heartily: "Excellent! Only this kind of resolve proves you are truly of the Chen bloodline!" His laughter echoed through the empty secret realm. "Rest assured, you and I are now in the same boat—harming your sister serves no purpose for me. Come, the aura of the Heavenly Eye grows ever closer." With that, he waved his hand, and a portal of light materialized in the void. "This is a shortcut to the depths of the secret realm. Keep close."

text.content: Chen Ji cast one final glance at the Jade Pendant in his hand before tucking it securely close to his body. His father's legacy, news of his sister, the truth behind the Tianji Record... within this single night, everything he knew had been completely overturned. He did not know how much of Ling Yuan's words were true, but he knew that from the moment he stepped through that portal of light, there would be no turning back. The storm that awaited ahead was capable of overturning heaven and earth, and he would stand at the center of this storm, stirring up a chess game spanning the realms of gods, mortals, and demons.
